name: Jitsi Meet Detection Suite
summary: JWT authentication failures, refused moderator actions, recording, and the health of Prosody, Jicofo, the videobridge and Jibri on self-hosted Jitsi Meet.
summary_zh: 自建 Jitsi Meet 的 JWT 驗證失敗、被拒絕的主持人操作、錄影，以及 Prosody、Jicofo、videobridge 與 Jibri 的健康狀態。
notes: Jitsi Meet has no decoders or rules in Wazuh. This pack decodes Prosody (the XMPP server), Jicofo, the videobridge and Jibri (the recorder) in the three shapes a manager receives: a syslog or journald line with a program name, the components' own log files, and the docker json-file log that docker-jitsi-meet writes by default. One rule serves all three shapes.

JWT authentication, from Prosody's token module: an expired token is level 3 (a tab left open past the token lifetime), a connection without a token level 5 (the meeting was opened without going through the portal), a token that this server did not sign or that is malformed level 8, a token used for a room it was not issued for level 6, a verification key that cannot be loaded level 7. Eight failures in two minutes are level 10: forgery attempts, or a portal whose signing secret no longer matches Prosody's.

These Prosody lines carry no client address. On docker-jitsi-meet Prosody sees every client through the web container, so no rule here can tell one client from another, and no blocking is offered on them. The real address is only in the access log of the web server in front of Jitsi.

Refused actions are level 6: a participant without the right asking to record or live stream, to end the meeting for everyone or to dial out, a join with a crafted MUC resource, an address over Prosody's login or join rate limit. The web client does not offer these to such a participant, so they point to a modified client or the API. Account or server administration through XMPP admin commands is level 8.

Availability: a component that loses its XMPP connection is level 7, one that cannot reach the server for minutes level 10. Single reconnection attempts are recorded below the alert level, because a Jibri retries every few seconds (measured: 1,455 attempts in one hour of outage from one recording host). A lost videobridge is level 7, no operational videobridge level 10, a failed health check level 7 and repeated failures level 10, five participants failing ICE in ten minutes level 7, gateway errors from /http-bind, /xmpp-websocket or /colibri-ws level 5 and ten in two minutes level 10.

Recording: start and stop are level 3, a live stream level 5, a failed recording level 5, a Jibri that reports itself unhealthy or cannot write its recordings level 7. Without a finalize script Jibri logs SEVERE "Failed to run finalize script" after every recording (measured: 33 times in ten days on one host, once per recording); that case is recognised and recorded below the alert level.

Deliberately not covered: guesses at a room password and lobby knocks (Prosody 13 and the Jitsi modules do not log them at info level), prosodyctl and the admin shell that replaced mod_admin_telnet (they write nothing to the log), successful logins (one per participant, left at level 0), and the meeting portal's own audit log.

The JWT is a credential, and it ends up in logs: Prosody's token_verification module writes the whole token into the line behind rule 132515, and the Jitsi client puts it in the URL of the page and of /http-bind and /xmpp-websocket. docker-jitsi-meet's web container redacts it in its access log; a web server in front of it does not unless told to (setup guide). Treat the alerts as sensitive.
notes_zh: Wazuh 對 Jitsi Meet 沒有任何解碼器或規則。本套件解碼 Prosody（XMPP 伺服器）、Jicofo、videobridge 與 Jibri（錄影程式），涵蓋 manager 會收到的三種形式：帶程式名稱的 syslog 或 journald 行、各元件自己的記錄檔，以及 docker-jitsi-meet 預設寫出的 docker json-file 記錄。三種形式共用同一組規則。

JWT 驗證（Prosody 的 token 模組）：過期的 token 為 level 3（分頁開著超過 token 有效期），沒有 token 的連線為 level 5（沒有經過入口網站就開啟會議），不是本伺服器簽發或格式錯誤的 token 為 level 8，token 用在不是簽發給它的會議室為 level 6，驗證金鑰無法載入為 level 7。兩分鐘內失敗八次為 level 10：有人在偽造 token，或入口網站的簽章密鑰已和 Prosody 對不上。
這些 Prosody 記錄行不含用戶端位址。在 docker-jitsi-meet 中，Prosody 看到的每個用戶端都是 web 容器，因此這裡沒有任何規則能分辨用戶端，也不對它們提供封鎖。真正的位址只在 Jitsi 前端網頁伺服器的存取記錄裡。
被拒絕的操作為 level 6：沒有權限的與會者要求錄影或直播、要求替所有人結束會議或撥出電話、用偽造的 MUC resource 加入、超過 Prosody 登入或加入的速率限制。網頁用戶端不會讓這類與會者看到這些功能，所以代表修改過的用戶端或直接呼叫 API。透過 XMPP 管理指令進行帳號或伺服器管理為 level 8。

可用性：元件失去 XMPP 連線為 level 7，數分鐘都連不上伺服器為 level 10。單次重新連線記錄在告警等級之下，因為 Jibri 每隔幾秒就重試一次（實測：一台錄影主機在一小時的中斷中重試 1,455 次）。失去一台 videobridge 為 level 7，沒有可用的 videobridge 為 level 10，健康檢查失敗為 level 7、持續失敗為 level 10，十分鐘內五位與會者 ICE 失敗為 level 7，/http-bind、/xmpp-websocket 或 /colibri-ws 回應閘道錯誤為 level 5、兩分鐘內十次為 level 10。
錄影：開始與結束為 level 3，直播為 level 5，錄影失敗為 level 5，Jibri 回報自己不健康或無法寫入錄影檔為 level 7。沒有設定 finalize 腳本時，Jibri 每次錄影結束都會記一行 SEVERE「Failed to run finalize script」（實測：一台主機十天 33 次，每次錄影一次）；這種情況會被辨識出來，記錄在告警等級之下。
刻意不涵蓋：猜測會議室密碼與大廳敲門（Prosody 13 與 Jitsi 模組在 info 等級不記錄）、prosodyctl 與取代 mod_admin_telnet 的 admin shell（不寫任何記錄）、成功登入（每位與會者一筆，保持 level 0），以及會議入口網站自己的稽核記錄。

JWT 是憑證，而且會出現在記錄裡：Prosody 的 token_verification 模組會把整個 token 寫進規則 132515 對應的記錄行，Jitsi 用戶端也會把它放在頁面、/http-bind 與 /xmpp-websocket 的網址中。docker-jitsi-meet 的 web 容器會在存取記錄中遮蔽它；前面另外架的網頁伺服器則不會，除非另外設定（見部署說明）。請把這些告警當成敏感資料。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: jitsi
agent_group.description: Jitsi Meet and Jibri hosts: the docker json-file logs of the containers and the access log of the web server in front

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Put a Wazuh agent on the Jitsi server and on every Jibri host, in the jitsi group
setup.title_zh: 在 Jitsi 伺服器與每台 Jibri 主機安裝 Wazuh agent，並加入 jitsi 群組
setup.body: The group reads the docker json-file logs of the containers (docker-jitsi-meet's default logging driver, no change on the Jitsi side) and the host's nginx access log. Only lines written after the agent starts are read. A Jibri on a separate host needs the agent too: its recording and XMPP messages exist only there. The wildcard covers every container on the host, so on a host that also runs unrelated containers prefer the journald step below.
setup.body_zh: 群組會讀取各容器的 docker json-file 記錄（docker-jitsi-meet 預設的記錄驅動程式，Jitsi 端不需要任何變更）以及主機上 nginx 的存取記錄。只讀取 agent 啟動後寫入的新行。獨立主機上的 Jibri 也需要 agent：錄影與 XMPP 訊息只存在那台主機上。萬用字元涵蓋主機上所有容器，若主機上還跑著其他無關的容器，建議改用下一步的 journald 方式。
setup.verify: Start and stop a recording. Expect rules 132560 and 132563 (level 3) from the Jibri host.
setup.verify_zh: 開始並停止一次錄影，Jibri 主機應出現規則 132560 與 132563（level 3）。

setup.title: Or: send the containers to journald with a tag
setup.title_zh: 或者：讓容器以標籤寫入 journald
setup.body: With the journald logging driver each line carries a program name (the tag), so the lines are decoded as jt-jitsi and reach the agent through /var/log/syslog, which rsyslog fills from journald and the agent already reads. Add the logging section to docker-compose.override.yml for each service and run docker compose up -d. This recreates the containers: running meetings drop and recordings stop, so do it in a quiet hour. docker logs keeps working. Afterwards the containers write no json-file log and the json-file entry of the group finds nothing. On a host without rsyslog, add a journald localfile to the agent instead.
setup.body_zh: 使用 journald 記錄驅動程式時，每一行都帶有程式名稱（標籤），因此會以 jt-jitsi 解碼，並透過 /var/log/syslog 送到 agent（rsyslog 會從 journald 寫入該檔，agent 本來就有在讀）。在 docker-compose.override.yml 為每個服務加上 logging 區段，然後執行 docker compose up -d。這會重建容器：進行中的會議會斷線、錄影會停止，請在離峰時段進行。docker logs 仍可使用。之後容器不再寫 json-file 記錄，群組中的 json-file 項目就不會讀到東西。若主機沒有 rsyslog，請改在 agent 加上 journald 的 localfile。
setup.code:
services:
  prosody:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: jitsi-prosody
  jicofo:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: jitsi-jicofo
  jvb:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: jitsi-jvb
  web:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: jitsi-web
# on a Jibri host: the jibri service, tag jitsi-jibri

docker compose up -d
setup.verify: journalctl -t jitsi-prosody -n 5 shows Prosody lines, and grep jitsi- /var/log/syslog shows them too.
setup.verify_zh: journalctl -t jitsi-prosody -n 5 可看到 Prosody 的記錄，grep jitsi- /var/log/syslog 也看得到。

setup.title: Redact the token in the access log of the web server in front of Jitsi
setup.title_zh: 在 Jitsi 前端網頁伺服器的存取記錄中遮蔽 token
setup.body: The Jitsi client puts the JWT in the URL (?jwt= on the page, ?token= on /http-bind and /xmpp-websocket), so a web server in front of the docker web container logs every participant's token, and the agent ships those lines to the manager. Use the same redaction as docker-jitsi-meet's own nginx: define the two maps and a log format in the http block and use it on the Jitsi server block, then reload nginx (no interruption). This is a change on the monitored host.
setup.body_zh: Jitsi 用戶端會把 JWT 放在網址中（頁面的 ?jwt=、/http-bind 與 /xmpp-websocket 的 ?token=），所以 docker web 容器前面的網頁伺服器會記錄每位與會者的 token，而 agent 會把這些記錄行送到 manager。請採用與 docker-jitsi-meet 自己的 nginx 相同的遮蔽方式：在 http 區塊定義兩個 map 與一個記錄格式，並在 Jitsi 的 server 區塊使用它，然後重新載入 nginx（不會中斷服務）。這是受監控主機上的變更。
setup.verify: grep -c 'jwt=ey\|token=ey' /var/log/nginx/access.log stays at the count it had before the reload.
setup.verify_zh: 重新載入後，grep -c 'jwt=ey\|token=ey' /var/log/nginx/access.log 的數字不再增加。

setup.title: Debian packages instead of docker
setup.title_zh: 使用 Debian 套件而非 docker 的安裝
setup.body: Add the Jicofo, videobridge and Jibri log files to the agent, and let Prosody log to syslog: its own log file starts with a timestamp that the Wazuh pre-decoder takes together with the next word, which breaks the line. Restart Prosody after the change (a short interruption of running meetings).
setup.body_zh: 把 Jicofo、videobridge 與 Jibri 的記錄檔加到 agent，並讓 Prosody 寫入 syslog：它自己的記錄檔開頭的時間戳記會被 Wazuh 的預解碼器連同下一個字一起取走，使整行無法解析。修改後需重新啟動 Prosody（進行中的會議會短暫中斷）。

active_response.title: Block an address that Prosody rate-limits for logins or joins
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖被 Prosody 以登入或加入速率限制的位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the address in rule 132525 on the Jitsi server, for 10 minutes. Only enable it when Prosody sees real client addresses: it needs PROSODY_ENABLE_RATE_LIMITS=1, PROSODY_TRUSTED_PROXIES listing the proxies, and every proxy in front passing the client address on. On docker-jitsi-meet with default settings the address in the rule is the web container's or the host proxy's, and blocking it cuts every participant off. Check the srcip of past 132525 alerts first: if it is a 172.16.0.0/12 or 127.0.0.1 address, do not enable this. Other risks: everyone behind one NAT address (an office, a mobile carrier) is blocked together. Put the proxy, management and office addresses in the manager's white_list. The JWT failure rules are not offered for blocking, because their lines carry no address at all.
active_response.body_zh: 在 Jitsi 伺服器上封鎖規則 132525 中的位址 10 分鐘。只有在 Prosody 看得到真正的用戶端位址時才啟用：需要 PROSODY_ENABLE_RATE_LIMITS=1、PROSODY_TRUSTED_PROXIES 列出各層代理，而且前面每一層代理都把用戶端位址傳下去。在預設設定的 docker-jitsi-meet 上，規則中的位址是 web 容器或主機代理的位址，封鎖它會讓所有與會者斷線。請先檢查過去 132525 告警的 srcip：若是 172.16.0.0/12 或 127.0.0.1 的位址，請不要啟用。其他風險：同一個 NAT 位址後的所有人（辦公室、行動網路業者）會一起被封鎖。請把代理、管理與辦公室位址加入 manager 的 white_list。JWT 失敗的規則不提供封鎖，因為那些記錄行根本沒有位址。
